title: The Exact Maximum of the Spectral Sum of Graphs
summary: For a simple graph $G$ of order $n$, let $S_2(G)=λ_1(G)+λ_2(G)$ denote its spectral sum. We determine, for every $n\geq5$, the exact maximum of $S_2(G)$ and all equality cases. The unique maximizer, up to isomorphism, is the complement of the disjoint union of a suitably balanced complete bipartite graph and isolated vertices, with the sizes of its three parts determined by $n$ modulo $7$. Denoting this graph by $K_n^\star$, we further show that $ S_2(K_n^\star)\leq\frac{8n}{7}-2,$ with equality exactly when $7\mid n$.
